facts.name: Netflix
sentences: Netflix's shares moved 5% or more on 8 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 29 October 2026, when the stock rose 0.1%.
The stock is down 33.8% this year, and at $62.08 it sits 46.4% below its 52-week closing high of $115.75 from 12 November 2025.
$1,000 invested in Netflix five years ago would be worth $899 today.
